title: They Said It Couldn't Be Built
description:
They Said It Couldn't Be Built

Four cases where the usual explanation runs out: the walls at Tiryns, the statues of Rapa Nui and the Altar Stone of Stonehenge, a drilled core from Giza, and the spaces inside Khufu's Pyramid that have been measured but never entered.

Every figure in this film is sourced. Where published figures disagree, the disagreement is stated instead of a number being picked.

CHAPTERS
00:00 Cold open
00:45 Act 1 — The verdict that is two thousand years old
04:54 Act 2 — The statues that walked and the stone that sailed
09:29 Act 3 — The hole in the granite
15:23 Act 4 — The cases nobody has closed
19:56 Outro

MUSIC
Ancient Civilisations - Alex Jones _ Xander Jones
Lake Jupiter - John Patitucci
Small Drama - documentary piano (Pixabay)
